full_judgment: 5. Mr Raziuddin Ahmed, learned Advocate appearing for the appellant, submits that the instant suit was hopelessly barred by limitation and in order to get rid of a point of limitation, the plaintiff has made some false assertion, in such view of the matter, the judgment and decree of the High Court Division is liable to be seaside. He further submits that the trial Court brought the lower Courts record of Title Suit No.5 of 1996 and examined the process server who categorically deposed that the respondent No.1 was not willing to receive the summons of the case for which the process server served the summon by way of hanging with the outer door of the respondent. He, lastly, submits that the High Court Division without appreciation of the evidence on record, erroneously reversed the well reasoned judgment and decree of the trial Court.
